title: GTA 6 Shoe Store: Where to Buy Shoes (Map)
h1: Where is the shoe store in GTA 6?
desc: The first GTA 6 shoe store is Flip Flop House in Key Lento. How to find every other footwear store with the in-game map filter, and how many there are.
lede: The first shoe store you can reach is Flip Flop House, right off Sunbelt Highway in Key Lento. On the left if you're coming from the north. Here's where it is on Rockstar's official map, and how to find the rest.
sections: Pinned on our interactive GTA 6 map too (zoom in to see the streets).
How to find every shoe store
Open the in-game map, pick Style, then the Footwear filter. Every shoe store gets a pair-of-shoes icon.
How many shoe stores are there?
Guides don't agree yet: PowerPyx and Gamertweak count 17, GTABase lists 14. The map filter shows all the ones you've found.
faq: Where is the shoe store in GTA 6?
The first one is Flip Flop House, off Sunbelt Highway in Key Lento. For the others, open the map and use Style, then Footwear.
How many shoe stores are in GTA 6?
Between 14 and 17 depending on the guide.
